page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Page number 509 at the head. A catchword "bum" stands alone at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: sub illa particula, quam dicunt παναγίαν[?] cor-
pus B. Mariæ contineri credat? Quid si
pluribus apud Græcos, illisque præstantissi-
mis Maria sanctissima innotescit? Quid si
excluditur plebs, & Magistratus ciuilis in
electione ministrorum Ecclesiæ? Quid si
Ieremias Patriarcha nihil, quod obiectiones
Tubigenses ferìat, asserat? Quid immane
elogium vitæ Monasticæ? Quid si tria, aut
quatuor sint Monachorum genera? Quid
si in recipiendis iuuenibus a nonnullis sciolis
præuaricentur Canones? Quid si a quibus-
dam eadem vis tribuatur peccata dimitten-
di habitui Monachico, & Baptismo? Quid
si Schismatici sunt in monte Atho, eoque
laudatissimo? Quid si panem consecratum
pretiosissimum corpus Christi in muro ap-
pendunt, & non sine veneratione conser-
uant? Quid si verbis transubstantiationis,
alias quoque preces adnectunt, verbis Do-
mini inuiolatis seruatis? Quid si Chemni-
tius dicit,antiquitatem non facere pro tran-
substantiatione, & fateatur ætate Dama-
sceni, & Teophylacti factam? Quid tot
aliæ ex cœnosa colluuie ineptiæ recollectæ?

l.i: Meretur hoc loco castigationem cruenta Alla-

page.notes: Greek word after "quam dicunt" read as παναγίαν with doubt; the first letters are not fully clear. The word "vox" after "Allatij" may be printed in a Greek or ornamented form; I read it as Latin vox. "afferat" read as asserat (long s). Text "fi" read as si (long s), "Schifmatici" as Schismatici, following the rule for long s. Line "Negant Ver-" carries a printed hyphen; the word continues as "bum" in the catchword.
